name: Color sync for ACF
author: Johan Jonk Stenström

sections.description:
Automatically get all colors from your theme to the ACF color picker and the customizer color picker.

Instead of having to define your colors twice; once in your theme, and once in custom ACF code, just use this plugin to get all defined colors from your theme to the ACF color picker automatically.
sections.installation:
Search for ACF Color Sync under Plugins on your WordPress install or download and:

  1. Upload color-sync-for-acf to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Edit awesomer (it’s a word, I promise)
sections.faq:
Is awesomer really a word?

No, it isn’t.
